description.value: Painted Rock Estate Winery is a family-owned operation perched on the eastern bench of Skaha Lake, producing ultra-premium terroir-driven wines from a 56-acre single-estate vineyard in the Okanagan Valley. The Skinner family has spent over 20 years crafting award-winning Bordeaux blends and single-varietal wines with the stated goal of raising the profile of Canadian wine internationally. A touring cyclist stopping here can visit the daily-open tasting room and take in sweeping views of Skaha Lake alongside tastings of some of Canada's most acclaimed estate wines.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active estate winery with a tasting room open daily, a wine shop, and event facilities on a 56-acre vineyard overlooking Skaha Lake near Penticton. The phone number (250) 493 6809 and email info@paintedrock.ca shown on the website match OSM exactly, confirming contact details. No evidence appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling-specific amenity, so all required criteria and most optional amenities default to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Painted Rock is a well-established, active business in a popular Okanagan cycling area and a compelling destination stop, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be verified from the website or OSM tags. On-the-ground confirmation of at least bike parking and washrooms is needed before listing.
